clause: Live boolean StudioCompoundShape + flatten + compound paths [STU-VEC-013,STU-VEC-070,STU-VEC-014]

scope.summary: Implement live vs flattened boolean result modes: live mode yields a StudioCompoundShape (boolean group) whose child geometry + per-child operator stay individually editable while the composite outline updates and participates in the appearance model as one styleable object; flatten is the general destructive-merge command producing one StudioVectorNetwork (distinct from group/ungroup and from expand-appearance). Compound paths (single object, holes via multiple contours under a shared fill rule) are a distinct construct with make/release; release restores independent child geometry.
acceptance_criteria: live StudioCompoundShape + explicit flatten + compound-path make/release; predictable identity loss
proof_targets: live-boolean editability + flatten + compound round-trip test
expected_tests: test: live boolean stays child-editable; flatten bakes one network (child identity lost, predictable); compound-path make/release round-trips independent geometry

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No live boolean groups / compound paths; non-destructive composition missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
